title: Guest Care Standard: The First Affected Night of a Travel Issue
content:
# Guest care standard — the first affected night

**Clause.** On an approved travel issue on a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, the first affected night is treated on its own, by how soon after arrival the issue was reported: when the request was submitted on the check-in date, the first affected night is refunded at 100 percent; when it was submitted on the day after the check-in date, the first affected night is refunded at 75 percent or at the share of the other affected nights, whichever is higher; otherwise the first affected night is refunded at the same share as the other affected nights. The night price is multiplied by the first affected night's share plus the share of each other affected night the refund covers.

The submission date is the date part of the approved request's submission time, compared with the check-in date recorded on the stay.

## Day table

| Request submitted | First affected night refunded at |
|---|---|
| on the check-in date | 100 percent |
| the day after the check-in date | the higher of 75 percent and the share of the other affected nights |
| any other day | the share of the other affected nights |

## Worked (hypothetical: night price 200.00, 3 affected nights covered, other nights' share 25 percent)

| Submitted | First night | Other 2 nights | Nightly amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| check-in date | 200.00 at 100 percent: 200.00 | 2 times 200.00 at 25 percent: 100.00 | 300.00 |
| day after check-in | higher of 75 and 25: 75 percent, 150.00 | 100.00 | 250.00 |
| two days after check-in | 25 percent: 50.00 | 100.00 | 150.00 |

With an other-nights share of 100 percent, a request submitted the day after check-in refunds the first night at 100 percent, the higher of the two.
